findings.title: Written aggressive-method invariant in Section 6.3 is a malformed boolean that contradicts the decision table and AC6
findings.location: design.md Section 6.3 (invariant bullet for 20:4/omad in alternatives)
findings.problem: The invariant 'goal === "weight_loss" && (intensity === null || intensity === "light") while exercises is false OR intensity is null/"light"' parses as (A && B) || C, so the trailing OR admits 20:4/omad alternatives for ANY goal with intensity null/light, contradicting the table (R5 alternatives are ["16:8"]) and AC6. Test authors transcribing this invariant build a wrong assertion that passes garbage.
findings.fix: Express the predicate as `const canOfferAggressive = answers.goal === "weight_loss" && (exerciseState(answers) === "none" || exerciseState(answers) === "light");` keyed on the already-specified total classifier exerciseState, so it matches R2/R3 exactly and keeps the degenerate exercises:true/intensity:null case (-> "none") correctly surfacing the aggressive alternatives.

findings.title: Custom plan is selectable in onboarding but its fasting-hours are never set there, producing a custom fast with undefined target hours
findings.location: design.md Section 14 step 4 (RecommendationStep renders full METHOD_ORDER selectable) vs Section 5 (METHOD_ORDER includes custom) and Section 8 (customFastingHours has no stated default; startFast trusts input-layer clamp that onboarding is not)
findings.problem: A user can tap Custom then 'Mulai sekarang' during onboarding. completeOnboarding sets chosenMethod=custom, but onboarding has no hours input and customFastingHours has no defined default, so startFast resolves targetHours from an unset/undefined value (the catalog placeholder 16 is explicitly flagged as must-not-use). Reachable flow lands on Home with an invalid custom plan.
findings.fix: Pick one and state it: (a) exclude custom from the onboarding list via METHOD_ORDER.filter(id => id !== 'custom'), making custom reachable only from PlanPicker which owns the hours input; or (b) give customFastingHours an explicit store default (e.g. 16) and state onboarding uses it until changed so the fast is always valid.

findings.title: persist partialize whitelist is undefined; the hydrated flag could be persisted and defeat the hydration guard
findings.location: design.md Section 8 (persist 'excludes nothing problematic'; hydrated flag via onRehydrateStorage)
findings.problem: The persisted key set is not enumerated. If the hydrated flag is part of store state, persisting it rehydrates hydrated:true from a prior session and defeats the useHasHydrated guard on cold load from populated storage.
findings.fix: State the exact partialize whitelist (persist onboarded, profiling, chosenMethod, customFastingHours, dailyGoalHours, theme, reminders, activeFast) and explicitly exclude hydrated and transient action state.

findings.title: Onboarding dailyGoalHours default for a custom pick is unspecified (uses catalog placeholder 16)
findings.location: design.md Section 14 confirm path ('dailyGoalHours default to method fasting hours') vs Section 5 (custom catalog default 16 placeholder) and Section 8 (warns 16 must never be a real target)
findings.problem: For a custom selection in onboarding, 'method fasting hours' resolves to the catalog placeholder 16, which Section 8 says must never be used as a real target. Same custom-hours ambiguity as Finding 2 bleeding into dailyGoalHours.
findings.fix: Fold into Finding 2's resolution: once custom cannot be chosen in onboarding (or has a defined default), dailyGoalHours on confirm is well-defined.
